name: Pay-To-View Lite
author: zzraz

sections.description:
Pay-To-View Lite enables time-limited rentals of digital media using PayPal and credit card payments. It’s perfect for selling or streaming your digital content with full control over price and rental duration.

External Services

This plugin includes a link to an upgrade information page hosted within the plugin itself, and integrates with PayPal for secure payment processing.

Upgrade to PRO (Static HTML Page)

The “Upgrade to PRO” admin menu item loads an HTML file from the plugin’s internal directory at: /assets/admin/upgrade-page.html. This page presents feature comparisons and pricing for Pay-To-View Basic and Pro.

  • Service: Local static HTML page (no remote API)
  • Used for: Showing feature details and upgrade options
  • External links: Includes outbound links to https://liserasmussen.se to get more information.
  • Terms: https://liserasmussen.se/pay-to-view/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://liserasmussen.se/pay-to-view/privacy.html

No user data is sent to external sites unless the user clicks a link.

PayPal Integration

This plugin integrates with PayPal using the official PayPal JavaScript SDK to handle rental payments securely.

  • Service: Uses the PayPal JavaScript SDK (client-side) to render payment buttons and process transactions.
  • Client ID: You must create a REST API app on the PayPal Developer Dashboard to obtain a Client ID, which is entered in the plugin settings. This Client ID is used to load the PayPal SDK and process payments in the browser.
  • PayPal Email: Your PayPal business account email is used to receive payments.
  • Data sent: When a user rents media, their browser loads the PayPal SDK and processes payment securely on PayPal’s servers. No personal data is transmitted to any third-party service by this plugin. The plugin does not use IPN (Instant Payment Notification) or store user data on external servers.
  • Terms: https://www.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/ua/useragreement-full
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/privacy-full

Key Features

  • Fixed rental price and duration
  • Secure PayPal payment gateway integration
  • Supports any media players like YouTube, Presto Player, HTML5 Player, JW Player, and more
  • Easy-to-use shortcode for embedding rental buttons
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly design

Upgrade to [Pay-To-View Basic] or Pay-To-View Pro for advanced features including:

  • Custom pricing and rental durations per media
  • Customization of rental button
  • Automatic plugin updates
  • Shortcode log
  • Export rental logs
  • Notifications on rentals
  • Priority support and more!

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later. See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files via the Add New plugin screen in WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Pay-To-View Lite to configure your PayPal Client ID, currency, rental price, and rental duration.
  4. On the Shortcode page, add all media information to start generating shortcodes. Copy and paste the shortcode on your posts or pages to add the rental button.
  5. On the Rental page, view the log with all completed payments.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the rental price and duration?

The Lite version uses fixed price and duration settings from the plugin settings page. For custom pricing and duration (set individual pricing and duration per media file), consider upgrading to the Basic or Pro version: https://liserasmussen.se/pay-to-view/pricing_plans.html.

Which video players are supported?

Pay-To-View Lite supports all players that works with WordPress.

How do payments work?

Payments are processed securely via the PayPal Client ID, supporting both PayPal accounts and credit cards. To create an application and get the client ID in PayPal, start here: https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/
